items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And my cousin Hersey(?), he played drums.

ctx.x: August Du Pont is his name. They called him Dimes. All the musicians would call him Dimes. He played. And my cousin Hersey(?), he played drums. And he has a son, they call him Bib, but his right name is [INDECIPHERABLE]
